files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to the images. Accepted: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: 1–100. 75 is visually lossless for most photos. With a target size, this is the highest quality tried.

targetSizeKb.title: Target size (KB)
targetSizeKb.description: Optional: the best quality that fits under this size, e.g. 200 for a 200 KB upload limit.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Optional: shrink wider images (keeps the ratio, never enlarges). 1920 or 2560 saves a lot on phone photos.

lossless.title: Lossless
lossless.description: Lossless WebP/AVIF and full-colour PNG (smaller savings, no quality loss).

keepMetadata.title: Keep metadata (EXIF, GPS, ICC)
keepMetadata.description: Off by default: location and camera data are removed.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
